snippet.title: PESTILENCE GAME Trailer │Green Trouble Games
snippet.description: Pestilence is a first-person stealth game where you will play the Lord of the Pestilence, a God betrayed by his brothers who seeks revenge against them. Make use of the plague's abilities to infiltrate a city inspired by Spanish baroque and infect its leaders.
